_about: Rules for app/layout/rows.py: how OCR text segments are grouped into printed rows. Measured in segment heights, so they hold at any image size.
_same_row_offset_per_height: Two segments are on the same printed row when their vertical centres differ by at most this many times the smaller segment's height. 0.5 = the centres sit within half a character height of each other. Starting value, to be checked by eye in the Stage A OCR panel.
_max_overlap_per_height: A segment cannot join a row if it horizontally overlaps a segment already in that row by more than this many times the smaller height: two pieces of text printed over each other are on different lines. Stops a value printed between two lines (e.g. a receipt number sitting between 'RECEIPT NUMBER:' and 'DATE:') from chaining both lines into one row. Found on yem_p2.pdf in the first Stage A run.
_wide_gap_per_height: A horizontal gap wider than this many row heights is shown with wide_gap_text instead of a single space, so a label and its value at opposite ends of a receipt line stay visibly apart. Display only; does not affect grouping.
